Hey Product Hunt 👋  
  
BrightBean Studio started because we got tired of how expensive social media management tools become once you add more clients, workspaces and users.  
  
My girlfriend runs a small social media agency managing several local businesses. She was paying roughly $400/month across tools like Sendible and Later, and the bill kept growing with every new client.  
  
So I built the alternative we wanted.  
  
BrightBean Studio is an open-source alternative to Buffer, Sendible and SocialPilot for people who need more than a basic scheduler but don't want another expensive per-seat SaaS subscription.  
  
It lets you:  
  
📣 Schedule and publish across 10+ platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads and Google Business Profile [...] 👥 Add as many users and workspaces as you need without per-seat pricing  
  
You can self-host BrightBean Studio on your own infrastructure, and the whole project is open source under AGPL-3.0.  
  
For people who don't want to deal with hosting, setup and maintenance, there's also a free hosted version.  
  
The project has now passed 2,400 GitHub stars, and the response has convinced us there are a lot of people looking for a more open alternative to the existing social media management stack.  
  
We'd especially love feedback from anyone currently using Buffer, Hootsuite, Sendible, Later or SocialPilot:  
  
What would make you actually switch?
